entries: Initial goal: port the extension by replaying the older branch.
Constraint: preserve the upstream notify_user and recall tools.
Decision: use a rebuildable SQLite sidecar beside the selected Kilo database.
Rejected path: do not retry the PGlite worker integration.
Exact command: bun run --cwd packages/opencode lcm:tree.
Numeric limit: soft raw-lane maintenance starts at 40 percent by default.
Promotion rule: hard maintenance promotes complete active summary levels until the configured soft target is feasible.
Issue ID: LCM-421 tracks the v7.4.21 compatibility review.
Completed work: newest-first message streams are normalized once before final-source indexing.
Remaining work: verify the corrected packaged VSIX on macOS and VSCodium.
Preference override: apply the current-state delta instead of replaying old commits.
Continuity rule: protect unconsumed current work and a recent tail of 15 percent, clamped to 2000 through 20000 tokens.
Release base: upstream Kilo Code v7.4.21 at a5aaef74a81edaa9b5dac9b6b459d7700b973b62.
Current goal: ship a frictionless single-session continuity layer without disabling upstream features.
